set.body:
Outcome
Show that theme changes cannot change scientific meaning or trigger analysis.

Owned scope
sampler scientific fixture; explicit rendering-policy boundary tests; pilot invariant specification

Prerequisites
B3, C2

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Use fixed synthetic values with an explicit LUT, thresholds, normalization, opacity and export policy; do not use general -color-chart-* values for scientific meaning.
- [ ] Across appearance, density, text scale, window move/popout/restore and perspective switches, assert identical source values, IDs, LUT entries, thresholds and saved scientific state.
- [ ] Count analysis calls and require zero recomputations from appearance-only changes; any resize/redraw is distinguished from analysis.
- [ ] Under a fixed export/rendering policy, deterministic exports retain identical data/colors; assert bytes or canonical pixel/data payload as appropriate, excluding explicitly recorded metadata.
- [ ] Test at least one chart and one scientific viewport fixture; document that these probes are bounded evidence rather than general scientific validation.

Required evidence
Before/after data and export hashes, LUT/state assertions, analysis-call counters and native viewport captures.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code D3. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [D3] Prove scientific appearance and state isolation
